commands_for_the_owner:
# or, from PowerShell, which also needs the password interactively:
$c = Get-Credential; Set-ScheduledTask -TaskName 'TradingAgentic-EDGE04-Forward' -User $c.UserName -Password $c.GetNetworkCredential().Password
not_applied_because: storing an account credential on this host is exactly what the security rules of this project forbid an automated agent to do; the change is spelled out for a person to make, and until it is made the sixty-day accumulation depends on the session staying alive

safe_unattended_modes.authorisation: the owner's decision; this work package leaves it registered as it is
safe_unattended_modes.limitation: a logoff, a reboot without an auto-logon, or a session that is closed ends the observation until somebody logs back in
safe_unattended_modes.mode: a host that stays logged in, with the screen locked

safe_unattended_modes.authorisation: REQUIRED — operator. The commands are in `commands_for_the_owner`
safe_unattended_modes.limitation: a credential would have to be stored on this host; the WP was not authorised to hold one and did not
safe_unattended_modes.mode: run whether the user is logged on or not
safe_unattended_modes.needs: the account's password stored for the task, or a dedicated low-privilege service account, and the policy to allow it

safe_unattended_modes.authorisation: not available on this host and NOT EXERCISED
safe_unattended_modes.limitation: still a user session; the durable form is a system service
safe_unattended_modes.needs: the same command under a timer, with Persistent=true

settings.reading: read by element path from the platform's own export; an element the platform omits is at its schema default, which is listed under *_defaulted rather than recorded as unset

what_the_platform_says_it_allows.logged_off: does NOT run: LogonType=InteractiveToken means the task needs the user's session, and no stored credential exists for it. This is the single largest caveat on the sixty-day requirement
what_the_platform_says_it_allows.logged_on_user_session: the task runs: the tick has been observed firing unattended on a schedule, without any agent or terminal open
what_the_platform_says_it_allows.machine_asleep: the trigger is missed and StartWhenAvailable fires it on wake; that path is declared by the registration and NOT EXERCISED here
what_the_platform_says_it_allows.machine_off_across_several_slots: the next tick ingests every bar that closed after the store's high-water mark, so the gap is latency and not data — EXERCISED by this work package as a real scheduler outage, see OUTAGE_REHEARSAL_*.json
what_the_platform_says_it_allows.machine_rebooted: NOT EXERCISED: a reboot would end this session and every other process on the host, which is an operator's decision and not a work package's
what_the_platform_says_it_allows.screen_locked_but_session_alive: EXPECTED to run — a locked screen does not end the session — and NOT EXERCISED: locking this host's screen would interrupt the person using it, so the work package records the expectation and does not measure it
